messages:
Lena (AE): quick thread: Fjord wants to trial their internally-tuned QLoRA 40B for a customer demo next week. main asks: EU-only processing, custom KMS, and a flat POC price. can eng confirm feasibility?
Rohit (SE): short answer: doable but needs temp catalog entry + validation. do we know the weight format (bits / fusion)?
customer-rep: weights are `.safetensors` q4f16 converted by our team. tokenizer is sentencepiece v1.
Maya (ML Eng): ok q4f16 + sentencepiece is promising. must validate tokenizer vocab hash and KV cache alignment. common fail: custom fused kernels break our runtime load.
Rohit (SE): plan: create `fjord-40b-qlora-temp-q4f16` catalog item scoped to eu-west1 Dedicated nodes, add fallback to `redwood-13b-q4f16`. run kv cache smoke (8k context).
Omar (Infra): EU-only: we can use Dedicated in eu-west1. Hosted with CMEK possible but control plane traces may route metadata out of region. Private deployment would be full EU residency.
Priya (Security): BYOK/CMEK supported. for attestation and rotation proof we prefer Private. questionnaire will need data deletion SLA and key management policy.
Lena (AE): pricing request: They want a single POC fee covering validation + 2-week Dedicated capacity. any ballpark?
Rohit (SE): ballpark: validation fee (one-off) ~ $8k equivalent engineering effort + infra burn for 2 weeks (A100 nodes) ~ $6k, plus hosted uplift if applicable. recommend present as itemized SOW.
Maya (ML Eng): estimate validation timeline: tokenizer & kv smoke (half day), conversion + perf run (1 day), 1k-prompt regression + hallucination check (1 day). total ~2.5 eng-days.
Omar (Infra): infra quote for 2-week POC (2 QPS baseline, 8k context): 2x A100-80GB dedicated (eu-west1) reserved for 2 weeks + small burst H100 access day: ~€9k.
Priya (Security): blockers: need their key policy, data retention expectations, and sample PII/PCI classification. I can draft SAQ answers once we have those.
Lena (AE): action items:
- Rohit: spin temp catalog entry + run kv smoke (target: tomorrow AM)
- Maya: run 1k regression + perf and share metrics (target: EOD)
- Omar: confirm node availability and exact POC infra cost (target: EOD)
- Priya: draft questionnaire responses and list missing customer docs (target: EOD)
- Lena: send itemized SOW with validation + infra + uplift pricing to customer (target: EOD tomorrow)
Rohit (SE): adding cache suggestion to reduce token cost: enable prefix caching with ttl 1800s during POC. include in SOW snippet.
Maya (ML Eng): will also run a short quality delta vs our 34B baseline to show expected tradeoffs.
customer-rep: thanks — I'll upload key policy and sample prompts to the shared folder by EOD.
Lena (AE): great, reconvene here after smoke tests. thanks everyone!
